name: Chat
description: White-label conversational shell — a branded chat surface over the agent loop. Streaming replies with tool-activity and inline tool approvals, stop/regenerate, code-block copy, inline images the agent produced, slash commands, Markdown export, and a settings drawer over the engine's own subsystems (skills, knowledge, memory, schedule, research). Branding comes from a workspace-level brand.json at runtime, so one shell white-labels per tenant. Shows the signed-in member's name on cloud; desktop has no login and shows none.
